text:
Rina S.: Quick sync 1 1 — thinking about tightening the console IA. Proposal: keep stable resource paths and push ephemeral panel/drawer state into query params. Regroup left nav to Workspaces / Models / Deployments / Observability / Billing. Add a compact breadcrumb strand above the header with truncation + accessible labels and an explicit 'Copy link' action that returns a server-canonicalized permalink. Mobile: collapse into a single pill that opens a bottom sheet. Thoughts? :seedling:

Marco V.: Love the stable-path approach. Engineering concerns: history churn if every little UI toggle writes entries. Rule idea: use history.replaceState for UI toggles (sort, filter, open/close panels) and history.pushState for explicit navigations (click on breadcrumb, open item). Also recommend a server-side whitelist for shareable params so we dont leak dev flags.

Ivy L.: A11y notes: announce breadcrumb changes with an aria-live polite region — suggested phrasing: "Current location: Workspace ACME, Models, model-xyz, revision 3". Skip-link must land on the active main panel (id changes when right panel is open). Breadcrumbs tabbable, last crumb gets aria-current="page". Tooltips need accessible descriptions (aria-describedby) and must be reachable by keyboard. Avoid opening flyouts on focus; open on Enter/Space only.

Jonah K.: Microcopy + UX: visible crumbs should be short (Models not Model Management) with full name in tooltip and aria-label. Add a small copy icon in the tooltip that calls POST /permalinks/canonicalize to get a cleaned URL. Toast after copy: "Copied canonical link" with a short preview line that truncates long IDs. Mobile pill shows e.g. "ACME · Models · model-xyz…"; tap to open sheet with full path + Copy. Analytics: breadcrumb_navigate, breadcrumb_copy, permalink_open.

Rina S.: Example canonical URLs for the spec:
```
https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models?panel=metrics&metric=latency&range=24h
https://console.redwood.ai/w/acme/models/model-xyz?revision=42
```
Shareable params: panel, metric, range, revision. Non-shareable: debug=true, ui_inspector. Also: handle legacy fragments by mapping `#panel=...` -> `?panel=...` on first load via server middleware.

Marco V.: Implementation checklist suggestion:
- Router middleware to canonicalize queries on SSR (strip ephemeral params)
- Legacy-hash mapping: map fragment -> query on first load and replaceState (no extra back entry)
- History manager rules: push vs replace by intent
- Copy-permalink API endpoint that returns server-normalized links
I'll spike a tiny middleware prototype and RFC.

Ivy L.: Keyboard specifics: wrap breadcrumbs in `<nav aria-label="Breadcrumbs">`. Each crumb is a button or link. On focus do not auto-open popovers. Pressing Enter activates. Last crumb uses aria-current="page". Live-region announcement should be short and localizable; add templates so translators can reorder tokens. Add e2e tests: skiplink lands on active panel, breadcrumb Enter navigates, aria-live announces new path, copy-link returns canonical URL.

Jonah K.: Visual idea: chevrons + truncation, tooltip shows full ID in monospace with inline copy icon. For ultra-long IDs show a copy-only control. Figma mock incoming: <https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/breadcrumb-experiment> :art:

A11yHelper: Reminder pinned: run axe checks and keyboard-only flows. Suggested tests: legacy-hash redirect mapping, replaceState behavior, aria-live phrasing, skiplink target, copy-permalink canonicalization.

Rina S.: Action items: Marco - spike router middleware + copy-permalink endpoint (due Mon), Ivy - draft a11y acceptance tests + localized live-region templates (due Tue), Jonah - Figma mocks and three microcopy variants for copy tooltip (due Wed). Can we pilot on a single non-critical workspace next sprint?

Marco V.: :thumbsup: I'll open an RFC in eng-platform and push a prototype middleware branch.

Ivy L.: I'll add acceptance tests to the a11y checklist and the PR template.

Jonah K.: Will post Figma link and copy variants in this thread when ready.

A11yHelper: Pinned: "NAV-999: Breadcrumb + permalink accessibility + legacy mapping checklist" and scheduled review meeting next Thu.
